Resolves #20577

Branches on `data?.cancelled` in both `Neo.calendar.view.week.EventDragZone#dragEnd` and `Neo.calendar.view.month.EventDragZone#dragEnd` so pressing `Escape` mid-drag tears down the proxy, clears `neo-cursor-move`, resets zone state, and re-renders from the unchanged `eventRecord` without committing moved dates or resorting the events store.

Evidence: L3 (local Playwright Chromium e2e + unit execution on exact head 5b4968f1aa) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline lint-staged jobs ran (`check-whitespace`, `check-shorthand`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-block-alignment`, `check-parse`, `check-derived-domain`, `check-fixed-sleeps`, `check-engine-brain-boundary`, `check-content-root-derivations`, `check-class-module-scope`).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | Outside-CI e2e: `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/rendering/CalendarMonthEventDrag.spec.mjs` — failed red-first on `dev` (`bc8a8c1bcb`) because week `dragEnd` mutated `record.startDate`/`endDate` from `2024-07-29T10:00:00.000Z` to `2024-07-25T10:00:00.000Z` on `Escape`; passes on `5b4968f1aa` (`1 passed (2.7s)`) with both week and month record dates and DOM day slots unchanged after `Escape` + release. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI e2e: `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/CalendarMonthEventDrag.spec.mjs` verifies that a completed drop in both week and month views moves the event DOM node into the target day column/cell and updates `record.startDate` and `record.endDate`. |
| AC-3 | `src/calendar/view/week/EventDragZone.mjs#dragEnd` and `src/calendar/view/month/EventDragZone.mjs#dragEnd` JSDocs document the `data.cancelled` behavior and `todo: ESC key` is removed. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered + local receipt: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/calendar` (`17 passed (723ms)` on `5b4968f1aa`). |

## Deltas from ticket
- Also calls `me.removeBodyCursorCls()` inside the `if (data?.cancelled)` branch of both `EventDragZone#dragEnd` methods: `src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs#onDragEnd` suppresses `drag:end` after `drag:cancel`, so `plugin/DragDrop#onEventDragEnd` does not run on `Escape` and `document.body` would otherwise retain `neo-cursor-move`.

- Green e2e receipt on `5b4968f1aa`: `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/rendering/CalendarMonthEventDrag.spec.mjs` → `1 passed (2.7s)`.

### `@neo-opus-vega` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-08T02:41:50Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained. Two `dragEnd` branches and their e2e spec. The change uses the cancel contract `DragZone#onDragCancel` already defines (the #20571 shape) and adds no abstraction.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** Pressing Escape mid-drag in the week or month view now skips the date commit and the store resort. It still tears down the proxy, resets the zone state and re-renders from the untouched record, and a completed drop still moves the event. I checked this at exact head `5b4968f1aa`:
- Both branches follow #20577's prescription and the #20571 precedent, where `SortZone#processDragEnd` branches on `data.cancelled` inside the zone.
- The one delta, `removeBodyCursorCls()` in the cancel branch, is needed. `src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs:49–50` suppresses `drag:end` after `drag:cancel`, so neither plugin's `onEventDragEnd` runs on Escape.
- Hosted `e2e-engine` selected the extended spec and passed it (`CalendarMonthEventDrag.spec.mjs:12`, 4.0 s). AC-1 and AC-2 are CI-covered, not "outside-CI" as the body's table says.
- Hosted `unit` went red once on an unrelated flake: `grid/Pooling.spec.mjs:458`, the #9160 budget arm (defect-note b1eb6a69). The failed-job re-run is green, and every check now passes.
- The repair touches no site outside the prescription.

What I looked for and found harmless today: the same suppression leaves both plugins' `isDragging` at `true` after a cancel. Its only reader, `week/plugin/DragDrop.mjs:252`, runs after a drag start has set the flag itself, so nothing observes the stale value at this head. If a reader ever lands, the plugins should listen to the zone's `dragCancel` event. The zone should not reach into plugin state.

**Findings:** None.

Optional nits, no round needed: the spec now covers the week view, so the name `CalendarMonthEventDrag` undersells it. It also ends with an extra blank line.
